caption:
Start here. Jacob's MC manufactures professional water leak detectors in Lithuania (EU), developed and continuously improved together with the professionals who use them.

The range: a tracer gas detector that finds even the smallest leaks in underground, underfloor and in-wall pipes, an acoustic detector for metal and plastic pipes under floors, in walls and deep underground, and a 2-in-1 platform that combines both.

Tracer gas is the most accurate method and pinpoints the exact source; acoustic is the most versatile. A thermal camera only shows where water has gathered. And tracer gas is not limited to water: it can test hot and cold water, steam, propane, butane, oil and fuel systems.

CE marked, used in more than 40 countries, a 1-year manufacturer warranty and dispatch within 24 hours on business days.

Order through the link in bio, or DM "LEAK" for a demo video.
